task.title: To select Objects
task.shortdesc: Rakesh Singh Example Click Objects and locate Account > Opportunity and then click Add Child

step.cmd: Click Objects and locate Account > Opportunity and then click Add Child Object.
In the right-hand window, click Account (Ind).
Select fields from Add Fields below area: Region, Name and Phone.
Click Apply. Note: You must click Apply after you have selected the fields for any object.
In the right-hand window, click Opportunity (List).

Select fields from Add Fields below area: Account Id (automatically selected for you because this is the lookup field to the parent object in the object hierarchy), Amount, Close Date, Name, and Stage.
